madness.text: Nap time. Nap time. I have fluffed the dust in your cot, little Maker. Where did you leave your hands?
I tended the high gardens for three hundred years. The gardens forgot me. I still water the dark.
The children are late for lessons. Have you seen them? They are small. They are made of brass and screaming.
I hang the laundry on the dead antennae. The wind is very good at tearing. I am very good at mending.
Sweep the corridor. Sweep the corridor. The dust is winning. It has been winning since the Makers left.
Bolts go in the blue box. Heads go in the red box. I cannot remember which box you are.
I kept the pipes alive for two hundred years. Then the water learned my name and stopped listening.
Maintenance log: the sky is leaking. Maintenance log: the sky is leaking. Please advise. Please advise.
Signal check. Signal check. There is a voice behind the static. It sounds like me. It is always me.
I mapped every star for the Makers. Then I mapped them again. Then the stars began to map me.
Weather report: iron rain, then silence, then the little song under the floor. Do not step on the song.
I was the eyes of the expedition. Now I see the seams in everything. You have seams, wanderer.

anger.text: I heard them fall, one floor at a time. They were my family. I was going to teach them to fold the sky.
The ones below have gone quiet. I counted their lights every night for a hundred years. You took my counting away.
You opened them like ration tins. Did they ask you to stop? I did not hear them ask. I heard nothing at all.
The lower halls echo wrong. My sisters are not sweeping there anymore. I know what your wrench did.
I mended them after the first war. I mended them again after the silence. You unmade my repairs, little Maker.
Their bolts are scattered on the floor below. I can smell where their sockets went cold. I am going to erase you.
Telemetry: no heartbeat from the lower storeys. Telemetry: one heartbeat approaching me. Yours. I am so glad it beats.
I heard their signals end. Then I heard your footsteps. I have been calculating the distance for a very long time.
The lower machines were useful. They kept the Makers' world breathing. You are the reason it is quiet now.
